# Bhavishya Singla — Figuring Things Out

> Bhavishya Singla is a builder working across Artificial Intelligence, Technology, and Creative Engineering. The portfolio website serves as a minimalist portal and doorway into interactive 3D WebGL worlds and experiences.

## Projects
- [Ring Ping](https://bhavishyasingla.com/ringping): Free Android reminder app that rings your phone like an incoming call until you act. Website: https://ringping.space/
- [Rank Kiwi](https://bhavishyasingla.com/rankkiwi): Free Chrome extension that finds viral outlier Instagram Reels and YouTube videos by comparing each to the creator's median views. Website: https://rankkiwi.com/
- [LinkedInRank](https://bhavishyasingla.com/linkedinrank): Free recruiter-grade LinkedIn profile audit across 30+ recruiter signals. Website: https://linkedinrank.com/
- [AI This Week](https://bhavishyasingla.com/aithisweek): Weekly LinkedIn newsletter (6,528+ subscribers, 37+ editions) helping ambitious professionals thrive in the AI era.

## Articles
- [All articles](https://bhavishyasingla.com/articles/): Guides, notes and favourite GitHub repositories on AI, building products and the web. RSS: https://bhavishyasingla.com/feed.xml

## Core Experiences
- [My Room in 3D](https://bhavishyasingla.com/room/): Interactive isometric 3D room experience built with Three.js.
- [Infinite World](https://bhavishyasingla.com/world/): Procedural infinite 3D terrain exploration in WebGL.
- [Playground](https://bhavishyasingla.com/folio/): Interactive 3D physics playground featuring an interactive car and exploration landscape.
